items.title: Abidjan Omni Retail Inventory Bridge
items.summary: Working-capital bridge for a multi-channel retail operator with verified order and repeat-buyer activity on Exportunity.
items.returnModel: Revenue-share model tied to verified platform sales.
items.riskNotes: Demand fluctuation and supplier lead-time volatility.
items.mitigations: Milestone disbursement and approved-vendor procurement only.
items.narrative: Capital is allocated to verified stock replenishment and monitored through order velocity, margin, and sell-through logs.

items.title: Benin Gold Lot Traceability Rotation
items.summary: Commodity rotation contract for compliant gold lots with purchase-order evidence and settlement traceability.
items.returnModel: Rotation premium model with evidence-linked payouts.
items.riskNotes: Commodity volatility and shipment timing risk.
items.mitigations: Direct vendor settlement, milestone checks, and documentary controls.
items.narrative: Each release is linked to validated purchase orders, compliance artifacts, and settlement events.

items.title: Ghana Farm Inputs & Yield Cycle
items.summary: Input-financing contract for production units with staged releases tied to agronomic and sales evidence.
items.returnModel: Seasonal revenue-share with quarterly visibility checkpoints.
items.mitigations: Tranche release linked to verified input purchase and field logs.
items.narrative: Investor capital is constrained to tracked input and logistics expenses captured on-platform.

items.title: UAE Machinery Asset-Backed Leasing
items.summary: Asset-backed machinery financing where capital release is tied to vendor payment and deployment evidence.
items.returnModel: Asset-backed model with periodic payout schedule.
items.riskNotes: Utilization variance and maintenance cost spikes.
items.mitigations: Vendor-direct disbursement and service-level evidence gates.
items.narrative: Funds are released by milestone against equipment purchase and operational deployment proofs.
